versions.content: Communication Management shall provide an interface which aggregates methods to send a notification on value change and to register a get and set function for the field value Status: DRAFT Description: The interface shall aggregate the methods to send a notification on value change, and to register a get and set function for the field value. It shall also be possible to aggregate any non-empty subset of these methods. In case the method to send a notification is included in the aggregation, the first subscription shall trigger an event to the client with the field value. ▽ △ Rationale: To share properties held in a central location with multiple consumers the providing application shall offer methods to query the current property value, modify the value and notify all consumers of changes to the value. Dependencies: – Use Case: The provider of sensor data notifies the consumers about the update rate. It also provides methods to the consumers to query and modify the update rate. Supporting Material: –
